name: API CO2 Booster
description: Liquid carbon source (glutaraldehyde-family) marketed as a CO2 supplement for low-tech planted tanks. Supplies bioavailable carbon, not a measurable ppm, so `contributes` is intentionally absent.
notes: Same sensitive-plant + invertebrate caveats as other liquid carbons — Vallisneria and mosses can melt. Label dose ~1 ml per 95 L (5 ml per ~25 US gal).
